summary: A streamlined, faster reboot of the classic Caylus, where players place workers to gather resources and construct buildings along the castle's road for points and bonuses. It keeps the worker-placement bones of the original but trims playtime and adds variable setup and character powers for more replayability.
praised: Faithful modernization that keeps Caylus's strategic depth
Shorter playtime than the original Caylus
criticised: Some feel it loses a bit of the original's grandeur
Still fairly dry/economic for players wanting theme
Comparisons to the original divide opinion on which is better

interaction.detail: Players place workers on a shared, expanding board of buildings (some built by opponents), so claiming an action space or a building slot can block others from using it that round. Resource production and scoring are tracked individually, but the central board where all the action happens is fully shared.

subsystems: building/action economy along the action queue
sources: prestige points from favors and events
bonus points from end-game scoring tiles
scoring.how_you_win: Players place workers along a shared action line each round to build buildings and gain prestige; the game ends once the road/era track is exhausted, and the player with the most prestige points wins.
